prompt: Create a polished 16:9 title key art illustration for Per-Hop Works, a friendly educational packet-factory game. No text, no letters, no numbers. Generous atmospheric negative space in left half for interface copy added separately by code; the charming readable factory occupies right two-thirds, with one hero orange crate close in lower right. No people, no screens, no readable symbols. High-end editorial game key art, carefully composed, inviting, simple enough for beginners, crisp geometry, restrained detail, wide cinematic composition.
